title: Byte reversal has minimum length 2 in the fourteen-family SSA AVX2 language
statement: Allowing every earlier value as an operand (SSA live values) and fourteen instruction families -- vpshufb, vpermd, vpermq, two-source vpalignr imm 0..16, two-source vperm2i128, eight low/high unpacks at byte/word/dword/qword, and vpblendd -- no one-instruction program reverses 32 tags; vpshufb; vperm2i128 does it in two. This exhausts the instruction set named in the original research brief.

formal.statement: encode_multisource_avx2_sequence(target=reversed, steps=1) is UNSAT; steps=2 SAT with replayed model.

scope: EXACT fourteen-family constant-control SSA language; excludes memory, insert/extract, logic, register allocation, scheduling.

evidence.note: 2,697 vars / 97,314 clauses; CaDiCaL seed 1223; 1,922,088-byte DRAT accepted; 2-byte truncation REJECTED (verified here). Not UP-refutable: load-bearing.

sources: Franchetti & Puschel, CC 2008 -- the antecedent: stride permutations proved minimal on SSE2/Cell by a human-readable Floyd argument

provenance.by: isa-calculus bootstrap (Claude Code session with axeyum)
